BEGIN:RESTORE
RESTORE 0461 was=09 now=09
RESTORE 6A/9A0 was=00 00000000 now=00 00000000
RESTORE IMR was=7D 75 now=7D 75
RESTORE VEC13 was=FD80:22F7 now=FD80:22F7
RESTORE 00BE/04BE was=FF/FE now=FF/FF (the BIOS sets both per INT 1Bh DA/UA and keeps its own record; the probe never writes them) USING DA=31
RESTORE 0094 written=01 0480=DB 0485 now=96 (0094 is write-only: handed back as the BIOS leaves it, 0485<-05CB, 0094<-09,0C; the BIOS's countdown stops the motor)
RESTORE 043F=20 A1/A3/A5=00 DMA ch2 masked (write-only: set, not read back)
END:RESTORE
END:DMAROUTE
